title: The documented blocks import cannot resolve
evidence: Built-package ESM consumer resolves @raydenui/ui/blocks and imports LoginBlock successfully.
fix: Publish the blocks entry, declarations, and export mapping; test the exact documented import from a packed package.

title: Optional chart dependencies are required by the root import
evidence: The isolated consumer imports the root with no chart.js or react-chartjs-2 installed. Charts now use ./chart.
fix: Isolate charts behind a subpath or otherwise prevent optional peers from being evaluated by unrelated imports. Test a consumer with no chart packages.

title: An initially open modal crashes server rendering
evidence: renderToString of an initially open Modal returns an empty string without throwing; mounting is deferred to the browser.
fix: Guard portal creation until a browser container exists and test initially open as well as closed server renders.

title: Documentation search is broken in the production preview
evidence: Production build indexes 49 pages. Live search for Accordion returns component and subsection results.
fix: Generate and serve the search index as part of the production build, then smoke-test an actual query.

title: Documentation examples and prop tables describe a different API
evidence: The 109 direct prop/literal mismatches are gone. However, form-control.mdx still passes boolean state setters directly to native onChange callbacks for Checkbox and Toggle and documents a boolean callback. Copying these examples fails type checking or stores an event as state.
fix: Correct native event callbacks to e => setChecked(e.target.checked) and compile complete copyable examples, including callback types.

title: Starter templates contain reproducible UI contract errors
evidence: The targeted compiler check across 12 TypeScript starter variants now finds zero of the previously tracked UI contract errors (previously 16 in 10 files). Full independent installs of all starters were not performed.
fix: Repair all framework/language copies together. Use SelectOption/onValueChange, native event.target.checked, valid variation strings and icon names. Build and exercise each generated starter.

title: Collapsed accordion content still receives keyboard focus
evidence: Collapsed content is inert. The new normal interaction test verifies skipping it with Tab, opening it, and returning focus on close.
fix: Coordinate hidden/inert semantics with the collapse animation; test closing while focus is inside.

title: Collapsed sidebar navigation loses destinations and names
evidence: Nested destinations now render, but the new flyout is clipped inside SidebarMenu’s overflow-y-auto nav. Browser probe: nav width 82px, scrollWidth 271px; submenu spans x=80–262px and its center cannot be hit. Rich-label children still require consumers to supply the optional label prop.
fix: Render the flyout outside the scrolling nav (portal or nonclipping layer), add dismissal/focus behavior, and verify pointer and keyboard access to real nested destinations.

title: The password reveal control is hidden from assistive technology
evidence: Login uses the accessible trailingAction slot; the hidden-focus flag is gone and the reveal-control interaction test passes.
fix: Use an interactive addon slot and an explicit Show password/Hide password name and state; keep decorative icon wrappers noninteractive.

title: TableBlock row actions and selection controls are unnamed
evidence: Named row selectors/actions and a meaningful actions-column header remove the previous TableBlock naming flags.
fix: Name selection and action controls using the row identity, and provide a visually hidden Actions column heading.

title: Progress indicators do not expose their visible labels
evidence: Visible labels now name progress bars/circles; normal interaction tests verify their names and values.
fix: Attach naming props and value semantics to the same progress element. Connect visible labels and give each upload a filename-specific progress name.

title: Charts have no accessible data alternative
evidence: Canvas naming is fixed and labeled categorical charts gain a table. Scatter/bubble datasets without data.labels still suppress the table. A built scatter chart renders a canvas but neither a table nor its x/y values, leaving the information unavailable to nonvisual users.
fix: Build the alternative from dataset points when labels are absent, including x/y/r values; test scatter and bubble data explicitly.

title: Shared accent and muted text colors repeatedly fail contrast
evidence: Contrast improved substantially, but active content still fails. Examples: success filled Badge 3.80:1, ActivityFeed link 3.07:1, and Input trailing-action example 2.94:1, all below 4.5:1. Raw disabled-control flags are not treated as independent component failures.
fix: Finish migrating readable text and action surfaces to paired semantic tokens; verify active Badge, ActivityFeed, metadata and custom-addon examples at 4.5:1.

title: Literal surfaces and text break dark mode
evidence: Many literal light surfaces are repaired. Dark Alert primary CTAs still fail: success 2.18:1, information 3.59:1, error 3.89:1. Some Header examples and fixed light story wrappers remain incompatible with the dark palette.
fix: Give every dark action an explicit contrasting foreground/surface pair; fix Alert CTAs and distinguish deliberate light islands from broken story wrappers.

title: SearchableTableBlock claims to sort without sorting
evidence: Local sorting now reorders data; normal interaction test verifies Alice/Zelda ascending and descending, rather than only the indicator.
fix: Implement sorting or expose a controlled sort contract that updates rows and indicators together. Test actual row order.

title: ButtonGroupItem unexpectedly submits surrounding forms
evidence: Grouped buttons default to type=button. The normal test verifies that only an explicit submit button submits.
fix: Default to type=button while preserving an explicit submit override, and test grouped controls inside forms.

title: Interactive tooltip rerenders steal focus while typing
evidence: Focus is moved on the opening transition, not every callback/child identity change. The hello typing regression passes without losing focus.
fix: Focus on the closed-to-open transition only; keep live callbacks in refs where needed. Test multi-character typing and parent rerenders while the popover is open.

title: Form adapters lose nested-field errors
evidence: Adapters use getFieldState for nested names. The nested profile.email error interaction regression passes.
fix: Use a nested-path resolver or the form library’s field-state API. Cover nested objects and field arrays.

title: The select adapter returns errors that Select cannot display
evidence: The adapter returns the error message, and Select now accepts it, displays helper text, and sets aria-invalid/describedby. Source and clean type check verify the integration.
fix: Give Select a defined error contract and associated error text/aria-invalid, and make the adapter return only supported props.

title: Banner clipping hides notification content on phones
evidence: The fixed-height clipping is removed. Narrow-layout regression passes, and the live 390px Banner page shows descriptions within its 308px preview content width. Rayden’s sm breakpoint is 320px; hidden sm:inline does not hide descriptions at the tested phone width.
fix: Allow content-driven height and wrapping; reserve space for dismissal/actions without hiding important copy.

title: The search-table toolbar exceeds phone width
evidence: Wrapping toolbar controls and responsive input widths pass the existing narrow-layout interaction regression.
fix: Wrap or stack toolbar controls according to available container width; let the search field shrink.

title: Theme defaults and custom persistence keys are ignored
evidence: getStoredTheme still reads the fixed rayden-theme key and returns system when missing, making the defaultTheme fallback unreachable in the browser. setTheme writes the custom key, which is never read back. Explicit preferences can therefore be ignored.
fix: Read the supplied key and distinguish no stored preference from a stored system preference.

title: Table selection becomes misleading after row changes
evidence: Fresh probe: selecting Alice checks Select all rows with indeterminate=false. Filtering to unselected Zelda leaves Select all rows checked while Zelda is unchecked. Selection IDs also are not reconciled when source rows disappear.
fix: Reconcile selection against the intended row scope, derive allSelected by membership, and expose an indeterminate/mixed header checkbox.

title: Title-table Search and Sort buttons do nothing
evidence: Title-toolbar Search and Sort now require explicit onSearchClick/onSortClick callbacks and are hidden when absent.
fix: Implement the toolbar actions or expose callbacks; state whether search/filtering is local or consumer-controlled.

title: Adding an accordion click callback disables expansion
evidence: AccordionTrigger sets its internal onClick before spreading rest. A consumer onClick replaces expansion behavior, so adding analytics can stop the accordion opening.
fix: Compose handlers and define cancellation semantics instead of replacing the internal action.

title: Counter starts outside its configured range
evidence: Counter initializes directly from defaultValue=0; only update() clamps. min=5 still permits an initial 0 and a jump to 5 on first increase.
fix: Normalize uncontrolled initialization and changed bounds; document invalid controlled-value behavior.

title: Banner displays a close control without close behavior
evidence: Banner defaults dismissible=true and renders its close button even without onDismiss. The advertised dismissal does nothing in default usage.
fix: Hide unavailable dismissal, require its callback, or provide a documented uncontrolled dismissal mode.

title: Modal can render inert or empty primary actions
evidence: Fresh modal probe with primaryLabel="" and secondaryLabel="Back" renders buttons ["Back", ""]. Default Save also renders without an onPrimaryClick callback. The footer can contain an unnamed or inert action.
fix: Render each action only when configured, and make default action behavior explicit.

title: Modal description can reference content that is not rendered
evidence: Fresh modal probe: description + showClose=false + no title produces aria-describedby pointing to a missing node. The description is lost.
fix: Render descriptions independently of title/close visibility and only reference mounted descriptions.

title: An open modal can retain a stale theme
evidence: The modal copies its nearest theme only in the effect keyed by open/mounted. A local preview/provider theme change while the modal remains open does not update the copied portal class.
fix: Synchronize portal theme context during theme changes or inherit a stable semantic theme container.

title: Remember me has no effect on the login contract
evidence: Remember me changes private state but onSubmit only receives email/password. An application cannot honor the visible preference through the public callback.
fix: Expose rememberMe in the submission/controlled contract and avoid promising a fixed duration the component cannot implement.

title: Login fields omit basic validation and submission states
evidence: Login still uses a text input for email, lacks required/autocomplete rules, and exposes no pending/error submission state. Invalid or repeated attempts receive no built-in feedback.
fix: Use email/password autocomplete and required semantics as appropriate, and expose pending/error state without hardcoding authentication policy.

title: Work-email login misnames custom identity providers
evidence: Work-email mode invokes the first custom provider but hardcodes Continue with Google. A supplied Microsoft or other provider is misrepresented.
fix: Use the configured provider name and define whether the variant accepts one provider or many.

title: Avatar status is communicated only visually
evidence: Avatar status remains a colored dot or verification icon without status text/ARIA. The user’s presence or verification status is unavailable nonvisually.
fix: Expose a short status description when meaningful, and allow explicitly decorative status usage.

title: Button group active state is visual only
evidence: ButtonGroupItem active changes classes only; there is no default aria-pressed/selected state. A selected option is indistinguishable to assistive technology.
fix: Define whether the group is a toggle group, single choice or navigation, then implement corresponding semantics and keyboard behavior.

title: Stepper status is not exposed programmatically
evidence: Stepper active/completed/disabled status remains visual only. Linear/segmented variants without the visible label expose no accessible progress values.
fix: Expose current step and status text; provide named progress semantics where the component represents measurable progress.

title: Read-only inputs lose the visible focus treatment
evidence: Read-only Input takes a branch that omits focus-within border styling while the native input removes its outline. Keyboard users can lose their focus location.
fix: Apply a consistent focus-visible treatment independently of editability; verify keyboard text selection.

title: Small icon targets are difficult to use by touch
evidence: Chip remove/filter buttons remain size-4 (16px); Banner dismiss is also compact. Small targets increase touch error rates. Assess the WCAG 2.5.8 spacing exception before claiming a blanket failure; 44px is the ergonomic target, not the universal AA minimum.
fix: Increase invisible hit areas or padding while preserving compact visuals; verify adjacent controls do not overlap.

title: Motion does not respect reduced-motion preferences
evidence: Spinner still runs spin/dash/juggle animations without a reduced-motion alternative. The newer motion stylesheet covers participating press/collapse elements only and does not solve Spinner’s perpetual motion.
fix: Apply reduced-motion behavior to Spinner and remaining component transitions, preserving a static loading indication.

title: Overlay placement can put content outside the viewport
evidence: Tooltip still uses fixed absolute side placement and transforms without collision handling; Select also opens below without viewport-aware placement. The previous edge-placement reproduction remains applicable to the unchanged placement code.
fix: Add measured collision handling and a constrained scrollable panel where needed; test all four screen edges.

title: Every documentation page carries a large shared client payload
evidence: Fresh production home HTML loads 11 script files totaling 6,032,951 raw bytes / 2,095,576 gzip bytes. The largest shared chunk alone is 1,779,621 gzip bytes. Small consumer Button imports pass their budget, but the docs continue to ship a large global component/demo registry.
fix: Split the global MDX component/demo registry by page and lazy-load heavy charts/illustration data. Add a documentation-route payload budget.

title: Story fixtures hide or introduce accessibility and mobile problems
evidence: Fresh scans still find 48 phone-overflow stories per theme (47 existing plus the new 420px Chart contract fixture). Most are fixed story wrappers or galleries, not proven primitive defects. Unnamed Card/Dropdown/Sidebar example buttons and repeated unnamed landmarks also remain.
fix: Make story wrappers fluid, label all example controls, and add narrow-layout cases without hiding content. Keep intentional galleries separate from component contracts.

title: The normal quality gate misses the defects in this report
evidence: CI now checks docs props and adds meaningful interaction/a11y contracts, but all 294 normal tests pass while the issues here remain. It still omits a full two-theme/phone matrix, story type checking, callback/snippet compilation and isolated-package/SSR consumer contracts.
fix: Type-check stories and compile snippets, then gate representative dark/mobile/portal/consumer cases with assertions on content and behavior.

title: HeaderBlock is an unfinished internal prototype
evidence: HeaderBlock remains unexported. Variant 11 now has a mobile menu, but href is still ignored in favor of buttons, disclosure buttons omit expanded/controls relationships, and activeIndex initializes local state without subsequent synchronization.
fix: Keep the unfinished HeaderBlock internal until links, controlled state and menu semantics are complete; preserve the newly added mobile menu.

title: Unlabeled form controls discard className
evidence: Checkbox, Radio and Toggle still consume className only on their optional label wrapper. Unlabeled controls return early and silently discard styling overrides.
fix: Define stable wrapper/input styling props and apply them in both labeled and compact modes.

title: Several starter and block actions promise unavailable behavior
evidence: Some optional actions are now hidden unless callbacks exist. Dashboard Settings still shows Change Avatar, Cancel and Save Changes without behavior; default social Login buttons and sign-up also remain inert unless wired. The distinction between demonstration and completed flow needs to be explicit.
fix: Wire local demonstration behavior where useful, hide unavailable optional actions, and clearly document the integration points instead of presenting inert controls as working flows.

title: Quick Send’s default label contains a typo
evidence: The default Quick Send label remains See all beneficaries; the typo is visible when onSeeAll is supplied.
fix: Change the default to “See all beneficiaries” and check neighboring shared labels.

title: The new Stepper accessibility test renders invalid data
evidence: The Contrast story supplies label/currentStep instead of title/activeStep. An explicit story type check reports three TS2353 errors. The ordinary suite still passes because stories are excluded from tsc; the intended step text/state is absent, so the test does not cover what it claims.
fix: Use valid StepItem data and activeStep; assert the visible titles and current/completed states, and type-check all stories in CI.

title: Dashboard starter notification switches have no accessible names
evidence: Both Settings switches are rendered beside ordinary paragraph labels with no label prop, aria-label or aria-labelledby. The Next.js counterpart repeats the pattern. Rendering the matching Toggle props confirms a role=switch input with no naming relationship. Visually nearby text does not name the control.
fix: Associate each switch with its visible heading using label or aria-labelledby across framework/language variants, and test accessible names.
